Only timing-qualified reset gates support reached-control-point claims; automatic reboot alone does not prove a gate was hit or expose memory/register contents.

post_dispatch_timing_control.interpretation: Treat dispatch completion as unobserved; investigate loading/entry/reset inside CoreDispatcher; no exact root-cause claim.

first_driver_return_timing_control.measurement: host monotonic elapsed until ADB enumeration, includes USB and Android boot latency
first_driver_return_timing_control.interpretation: Timing response supports reaching the gate after CoreStartImage returns for actual scheduled ordinal 1. Return status and module GUID were not captured; this is not successful initialization, dispatcher completion or GOP proof.

ordinal8_return_timing_control.interpretation: Initial pair inconclusive; repeat with identical 2s image supports reaching ordinal8 post-CoreStartImage gate. Preserve all samples; GUID/status/whole-dispatch completion unobserved.

ufs_before_entry_timing_control.interpretation: Complete GUID and timing-qualified immediate pre-CoreStartImage gate support UFSDxe loaded and ready for entry call. Post-entry return remains unobserved; no exact internal failure/reset-source claim.

display_before_entry_timing_control.interpretation: All samples preserved. Repeat pair supports reaching the exact DisplayDxe GUID immediately before CoreStartImage. Its post-return gate remains unobserved; no vendor-body execution, GOP, or root-cause proof.

direct_pe_entry_timing_control.interpretation: 2/7/2 samples support reaching exact Display PE pre-call; vendor wrapper/body and successful return remain unproved

unhandled_exception_timing_control.interpretation: No 5-second response to 2/7-second selection; default DumpCpuContext gate not observed. Does not exclude registered handlers, pre-hook faults or other reset sources.

canary_prefix_presence_timing_control.interpretation: All samples retained. Supports matching configuration GUID prefix before Display PE call. Does not validate full GUID, canary value, wrapper execution, constructors, GOP or XNU. Missing-prefix point25 was host-tested but not device-tested.

global_pool_search_timing_control.interpretation: Success gate27 delay response supports executing the hook. Failed search gate26 was not observed; does not exclude other allocation failures or establish zero failures/exhaustion.
